authors: Z. Bern, S. Davies, T. Dennen
title: Enhanced ultraviolet cancellations in N=5 supergravity at four loops
claim: Four-loop four-point N=5 supergravity amplitudes are UV finite in D=4, contrary to expectations from supersymmetry and duality-symmetry counterterm arguments; the cancellations ('enhanced cancellations') cannot be manifest diagram by diagram in any covariant local formalism. Three-loop N=4 and N=5 amplitudes show the same.
scheme: Integrand from colour-kinematics duality; standard UV extraction with FIRE5 integral reduction; regularization not specified in the abstract.
symmetry_argument: None beyond the double-copy construction; the result contradicts symmetry-based counterterm expectations.

proved: UV finiteness of the computed four-loop four-point N=5 integrand in D=4.

evidence: Abstract: four-loop finiteness; enhanced cancellations; FIRE5.
red_flags: Shows that symmetry-based (counterterm) reasoning about divergences can fail: the vanishing is not explained by known symmetries; relevant as a caution when inferring protection from symmetry alone.
cross_checks: Contrast with S1d.08_BDDSS2013 (N=4 diverges at four loops) and S1d.07_BCCEJPRZ2018.
